projects.name: autumn
projects.description: Developed using Spring, Spring Boot, Redis, MyBatis, Shiro, and Druid frameworks, with MySQL as the database. If you are tired of manually creating tables in MyBatis, this project is perfect for you, as it automatically generates tables for you. You no longer need to import SQL files, making project initialization exceptionally simple, with a clear structure that is easy to develop and truly usable. It is fully annotated MyBatis development, with no mapper files; all SQL mappings are implemented in code, with no XML configuration at all, making it a blessing for those who have a fear of writing XML mapper files. It provides bidirectional generation functionality: entity classes automatically generate database tables without any SQL statements, all tables are generated automatically, and basic structural code is generated through table generation, which includes CRUD functionality, and all table-level API interfaces are available. Basic instance data is fully initialized automatically through code, requiring no intervention. You only need to modify the database connection address, username, and password to start running.
projects.originalDescription: 采用Spring、Spring Boot、Redis、MyBatis、Shiro、Druid框架开发,搭载mysql数据。  如果你厌烦了MyBatis中需要手动创建表的事情，这个项目非常适合你，自动为你生成表。  从此你不在需要导入sql文件了，项目初始化变得异常简单，结构清晰，易于开发，真正拿来可用。  全注解MyBatis开发，没有任何mapper文件，一切sql 映射都用代码实现，全程无xml配置，对xml编写mapper有恐惧症的人的福音。  提供双向生成功能：  实体类自动生成数据库表，全过程不需要任何SQL语句，所有表自动生成 通过表生成基础结构代码，生成代码中已包含CRUD功能，表级别的API接口全部都有 基本实例数据全自动通过代码初始化，无需干预 仅仅只需要修改数据库连接地址，用户名，密码，即可启动运行。
